Use the original card's colors, subdued pattern, logo placement and composition faithfully. Do not add ornamental banknote guilloche, flowers, luxury paper, new gradient art, new branding, new badges or a UI layout. This is just reusable static background artwork, the app will render all labels and personal data later.

Remove all sample portraits and silhouettes and leave a simple EMPTY pale-grey portrait area only where a portrait belongs. Remove QR/barcodes and leave their areas plain and unobstructed. No personal data, no invented identity details, no stamps or recreated holograms/security authentication marks. Do not include the reference's surrounding page, repeated merchant watermarks or background.
Use ONLY the TOP/FRONT card in the two-card reference. White face, Indian emblem upper-left, orange and green brush strokes centered at top, Aadhaar logo upper-right, faint large grey fingerprint watermark behind the middle, empty portrait at x3â€“26%,y30â€“77%; blank details middle and blank QR area right. Keep the thin red horizontal line at y88% and white footer.
